# Pact

Pact is a contract-first AI software engineering framework.

Website: https://pact.tools/
Documentation: https://pact.tools/docs/
Source: https://github.com/wandercom/pact
Package: https://pypi.org/project/pact-agents/

Core idea: decide architecture, contracts, tests, readiness, and production gates before implementation. Pact defaults to plan-only, then hands the implementation to Claude, Codex, or an explicitly enabled Pact implementation phase.

Readiness profile dimensions: operational maturity, security, privacy, compliance, gating, testing, monitoring.

Related suite: https://exemplar.tools, https://signet.tools, https://kindex.tools, https://centaur.tools, https://herald.tools, https://simulacrum.tools, https://reeve.tools, https://perardua.dev
